evidence_text: `a_read_error_preserves_completed_alerts_and_unfinished_bytes`, `read_errors_before_a_complete_line_preserve_the_cursor_and_retry_bytes` (fault injected through the actual buffered scanner).
statement: Complete records read before a later I/O error are returned alongside the error; unfinished bytes and their starting position survive for retry. Byte/line quotas still apply.
